subject: Security package — audit logs, HSM seats and residency tradeoffs
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@veridianhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security package q — audit logs + HSM

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're scoping Redwood's compliance add-ons for a pilot and I have a few quick questions so we can get procurement started:

- Audit log retention: how do your tiers look (30/90/365)? Can we export logs on demand?
- HSM: do you sell seats or pass-through licensing? What's a pilot price for one seat for 3 months?
- Data residency: any surcharge for US east region? Can we request a limited residency pilot for Q2?
- Implementation & evidence: is there an implementation fee and can you provide SOC 2 Type II and BAA sign-off quickly?

Procurement contact: procurement@veridianhealth.com. Their PO cutoff is mid‑March.

Can you send a high‑level pricing structure and any docs we can attach to the PO?

Best,
Anna
Head of Security Operations
Veridian Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-03T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security package q — audit logs + HSM

Hi Anna — appreciate the clear asks. High level pricing options attached (see redwood-auditlog-brochure.pdf) but short version below.

Audit log retention (monthly):
- 30 days: $1,200
- 90 days: $2,800
- 365 days: $9,600
- Exports: CSV/NDJSON on demand (one‑time export fee $250) or self‑serve via API at no incremental cost for customers with the 90/365 tier.

HSM options (two modalities):
1) Seat-based (managed HSM): $8,500/month per HSM seat (includes up to 100k HSM ops/month). Overage $0.00009/op.
2) Pass-through license (customer HSM license amortized): upfront $78,000 + $2,500/month maintenance. Ops billed at $0.00005/op.

Data residency: US‑EAST residency surcharge: $3,500/month (covers dedicated tenancy + audit scoping). We can do a 90‑day residency pilot with a reduced surcharge (50% off for the pilot period) if you commit to a 12‑month conversion after pilot.

Implementation & evidence:
- Implementation SOW: $22,000 (can be amortized as monthly credits against committed spend).
- SOC 2 Type II and BAA: we will provide SOC 2 report and a standard BAA; I can attach SOC2 evidence (SOC2-summary.pdf) for procurement.

Pilot concession we can offer while procurement reviews:
- One managed HSM seat at 25% off for the first 3 months (so $6,375/mo) if you provide a PO by 15‑Mar and agree to a 12‑month residency conversion.
- Waive the export fee for audit logs during the pilot.

I've attached the brochure and a high‑level SOW stub. If that looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30‑minute call Thurs to lock terms?

Thanks,
Mina
Sr. Sales Director
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-auditlog-brochure.pdf, SOW-stub.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-04T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security package q — audit logs + HSM (counter strategy)

Mina — quick thoughts from my side on negotiation posture:

- Offer structure: keep seat list price but concede 25% for pilot as proposed. Ask for PO cutoff March 15 and 12‑month conversion language.
- Implementation: propose waiving SOW fee if they commit to the 12‑month residency conversion OR accept a $12k upfront credit against first 3 invoices.
- Residency surcharge: reduce pilot surcharge to 50% as you suggested but require a firm conversion milestone in the contract (60 days after pilot end).
- For procurement: provide SOC2-summary and a redlined BAA ready for signature; that moves PO faster.

I'll draft a short concession matrix and a one‑pager for finance to speed approvals. Happy to jump on the call Thurs.

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales
From: Anna Lopez <anna@veridianhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: 2027-02-04T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security package q — audit logs + HSM

Mina,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — helpful.

A few asks from procurement/security that could get this over the line:

1) Can the managed HSM seat pilot price be $6,000/mo (we only need one seat for the PoC)?
2) Can you waive the implementation SOW fee for the pilot (we'll accept amortization if we convert to 12 months)?
3) Residency surcharge: can you apply the 50% pilot discount and cap total pilot surcharge at $3,500 (not per month)?
4) Need SOC2 report and a signed BAA to attach to the PO. Procurement notes their internal signoff window ends 15‑Mar, so PO will be available before then if docs are provided.

If you can confirm these concessions, I'll fast‑track a PO and internal memos.

Best,
Anna

On Wed, Feb 3, 2027 at 11:04 AM Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Anna — appreciate the clear asks. High level pricing options attached ...
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-05T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security package q — audit logs + HSM

Hi Anna — thanks. We can bridge most of these requests to get procurement comfortable; final counter below:

- Managed HSM pilot seat: $6,800/month for first 3 months (we'll apply 20% off the list price of $8,500 for the pilot). This is conditional on PO by 15‑Mar and commitment language to convert to a 12‑month residency contract at conclusion of pilot.
- Implementation SOW fee: waived for the pilot if you sign the 12‑month conversion commitment; otherwise we offer a $12k credit against first invoice.
- Residency surcharge: capped at $3,500 total for the 90‑day pilot (as requested) if PO provided by 15‑Mar.
- Audit logs: we'll waive export fees and include the 90‑day retention tier at $2,800/month for pilot. If you opt into 365 days after pilot we can discuss an annual discount.

Attachments I've included for procurement:
- SOC2-summary.pdf (redwood SOC 2 Type II summary)
- BAA-redwood-veridian.docx (fillable BAA)
- Veridian-proposal-20270205.pdf (line-item pricing and pilot terms)

Next steps:
- If that package works, procurement can attach the PO to the proposal and we'll route contract for signature. I'm free Thurs 10:00–11:00 PT for a short finalize call.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Veridian onboard for the pilot.

Mina
Sr. Sales Director
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, BAA-redwood-veridian.docx, Veridian-proposal-20270205.pdf
